input: In one or two sentences, what does an HTTP 404 status code mean?
acceptable_responses: A 404 means the server could not find the requested resource.
HTTP 404 Not Found: the requested page or resource does not exist on the server.
notes: Any phrasing that says the resource was not found is fine.

input: What is the boiling point of water at sea level, in Celsius?
acceptable_responses: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
unacceptable_responses: Water boils at 90 degrees Celsius at sea level.
notes: unacceptable_responses lets the reason flag a close-but-wrong answer.

input: Summarize the difference between RAG and fine-tuning in one sentence.
acceptable_responses: RAG retrieves external documents at query time, while fine-tuning updates the model's weights on new training data.
Fine-tuning changes the model itself; RAG leaves the model alone and adds retrieved context to the prompt.
notes: Per-case metric override: rouge_l also rewards matching word order.
